name: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau De Parfum for Men (100ml)
description: A bold, intense men's cologne representing modern masculinity. Crisp bergamot and spicy ginger are sharpened by an apple accord, contrasting with elegant sage and rich cedarwood.

name: Non-Stick Granite Marble Master Pan Set
description: Upgrade your kitchen with effortless non-stick performance. Heavy-gauge die-cast aluminum body provides rapid, even heat distribution with zero hot spots. Compatible with gas, electric, ceramic, and induction stoves.

name: Apple Watch Series 9 GPS 45mm Midnight Aluminum
description: Apple Watch Series 9 delivers powerful health and fitness tracking with the new S9 SiP processor. Features magical double-tap navigation, advanced ECG, blood oxygen tracking, crash detection, and all-day battery life.

name: Ultrasonic Aromatherapy Essential Oil Diffuser with Ambient LED (500ml)
description: Transforms your living space into a relaxing spa oasis. Delivers micro-fine aromatic mist for up to 12 hours with quiet ultrasonic vibration and intelligent waterless auto power-off.

name: Anker 737 Power Bank (PowerCore 24K, 140W Output)
description: Equipped with the latest Power Delivery 3.1 and bi-directional technology to quickly recharge the portable charger or get a 140W ultra-powerful charge for MacBook Pro, iPhone, and Samsung devices.

name: Al Haramain Amber Oud Gold Edition (60ml)
description: Amber Oud Gold Edition is a luxurious oriental fragrance that captures elegance with sweet, sparkling top notes followed by rich amber and sensual musk. Extraordinary longevity and sillage suitable for both daily wear and special occasions.

name: Sundarban 100% Raw Wildflower Honey (500g Glass Jar)
description: Pure, natural wildflower honey sourced from deep inside the Sundarbans mangrove forest. Retains all living enzymes, floral pollen, and natural antioxidants. Completely unadulterated without added sugars or artificial preservatives.

name: Dior Sauvage Eau De Parfum (100ml)
description: A powerful and noble fragrance, Dior Sauvage Eau de Parfum unfurls an olfactory score that oscillates between raw freshness and sensual, mysterious warmth. Accents of smoked vanilla absolute enveloped in amber notes create an unmistakable signature.

name: Nuby 360-Degree Spill-Proof Wonder Trainer Cup (300ml)
description: Supports healthy oral development by allowing toddlers to drink from anywhere around the rim without spilling or leaking. Easy-grip handles fit small hands comfortably.

name: Automatic Ratchet Genuine Leather Formal Dress Belt (Classic Black)
description: Say goodbye to stretched holes. This modern formal belt features a 32-position hidden ratchet track allowing 1/4-inch micro adjustments throughout the day. Finished with sleek scratch-resistant alloy buckle.

name: Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard 100% Whey Protein (Double Rich Chocolate, 2 lbs)
description: The world's #1 selling whey protein powder. Formulated with whey protein isolates as the primary ingredient to help build lean muscle, accelerate athletic recovery, and support everyday nutritional goals.

name: Lattafa Asad Eau De Parfum for Men (100ml)
description: Lattafa Asad is an intoxicating, masculine fragrance featuring bold notes of black pepper, tobacco, pineapple, coffee, and patchouli. Long-lasting performance that turns heads.

name: Laneige Lip Sleeping Mask Berry Hydrating Overnight Treatment (20g)
description: Cult-favorite Korean leave-on lip mask that soothes and moisturizes for visibly smoother, baby-soft lips. Features Moisture Wrap™ technology with hyaluronic acid to hold in active ingredients overnight.

name: Royal Silk Embroidered Festive Panjabi
description: Crafted from fine silk-viscose blended fabric with immaculate hand-embroidered detailing along the placket and collar. Cut in a modern slim fit that exudes timeless cultural elegance for Eid, weddings, and festive gatherings.

name: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 EDP (70ml)
description: One of the most legendary niche perfumes in modern history. An intimate, poetic alchemy where the aerial notes of jasmine and the radiance of saffron carry mineral facets of ambergris and woody tones of freshly cut cedar.

name: Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless ANC Headphones
description: Sony's flagship WH-1000XM5 headphones rewrite the rules for distraction-free listening. With 2 processors controlling 8 microphones, Auto NC Optimizer, and an ultra-comfortable lightweight design in soft fit leather.

name: Dyson V8 Extra Cordless Stick Vacuum Cleaner
description: Lightweight cordless versatility with powerful Dyson suction. Powered by the Dyson digital motor V8, spinning at up to 107,000 rpm to create strong suction on carpets and hard floors with de-tangling Motorbar.

name: Apple iPad 10th Generation 64GB Wi-Fi (10.9-Inch Liquid Retina Display)
description: Redesigned with an all-screen 10.9-inch Liquid Retina display, the powerful A14 Bionic chip, USB-C connectivity, and Touch ID on the top button. Perfect for creative work, studying, streaming, and productivity.

name: Armaf Club De Nuit Intense Man EDT for Men (105ml)
description: The worldwide champion of compliments. A provocative woody spicy scent opens with fresh fruity notes of lemon, apple, and blackcurrant leading to its opulent smoky floral heart of birch and jasmine.

name: Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Headphones
description: The Sony WH-1000XM5 rewrites the rules for distraction-free listening. Two processors control 8 microphones for unprecedented noise cancellation and crystal clear hands-free calling.

name: High-Density Non-Slip Eco Yoga Mat with Carry Strap (6mm Cushioning)
description: Constructed with premium odorless TPE material that cushions spine, hips, knees, and elbows on hard floors. Dual-sided non-slip texture keeps your hands firmly rooted during sweaty workouts.

name: Puma Softride Rift Lightweight Slip-On Running Shoes
description: Engineered with Puma's plush SOFTRIDE foam midsole for extreme everyday cushioning. Features an elastic slip-on collar, zoned rubber traction pods, and bold athletic branding.

name: Kiehl's Ultra Facial Cream 24-Hour Daily Hydration (50ml Jar)
description: Kiehl's #1 global face cream formulated with renewable Glacial Glycoprotein and olive-derived Squalane. Strengthens skin's moisture barrier and protects even in harsh AC environments.

name: Sudocrem Antiseptic Healing Diaper Rash Cream (125g)
description: Sudocrem has been parent's trusted ally for over 90 years. Forms a water-repellent barrier that stops irritants from contacting skin while zinc oxide promotes natural healing.

name: Chicco Natural Sensation Bath Shampoo Tear-Free (500ml)
description: Formulated with natural plant ingredients to respect baby's delicate skin and eyes. Clinically tested hypoallergenic, paraben-free, and phenoxyethanol-free from day one.

name: Organic Soft Cotton Baby Rompers (3-Pack)
description: A set of three newborn to toddler onesies crafted from ultra-soft certified organic cotton. Features expandable lap shoulder necklines and bottom snap closures to simplify dressing and diaper changes.

name: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star
description: The Chuck Taylor All Star is the quintessential everyday shoe. Lightweight durable canvas upper, medial eyelets for airflow, and the classic diamond pattern rubber sole for traction and signature street style.

name: Pampers Premium Protection Diaper Pants (Size 4 Mega)
description: Give your baby the #1 comfort and skin protection from Pampers. Featuring micro-pore air channels that allow air to circulate freely, wetness indicator line, and ultra-stretchy waistbands for easy diaper changes.

name: Anker 20,000mAh 22.5W High-Speed Power Bank
description: Equipped with 22.5W PowerIQ and Power Delivery fast-charging technology. Charge 3 devices simultaneously with 2 USB-A and 1 USB-C ports. Built-in MultiProtect safety system protects your devices from overcurrent and short circuits.

name: PanOxyl Antimicrobial Acne Foaming Wash 10% (156g)
description: Maximum strength foaming wash contains 10% Benzoyl Peroxide to clear tough blemishes quickly and prevent new breakouts from forming. Perfect for back, chest, and facial acne.

name: Ray-Ban Classic Aviator Gradient Sunglasses (RB3025 Gold / Brown)
description: Originally designed in 1937 for US aviators, the iconic Ray-Ban Aviator delivers unmistakable style and optimal clarity. Features lightweight gold wireframe construction and gradient crystal lenses with laser-etched RB signature.

name: Natural Himalayan Pink Rock Salt Fine Ground (1kg Shaker Jar)
description: Mined from ancient mineral deposits at the foothills of the Himalayas. 100% natural, unbleached, and free from microplastics or chemical anticaking agents. Adds smooth, balanced flavor to culinary dishes.

name: Extra Virgin Cold-Pressed Olive Oil (750ml Glass Bottle)
description: Pressed from hand-picked Andalusian olives within 24 hours of harvest. Delivers an intense fruity aroma with subtle peppery finish, perfect for light sautéing, salad dressings, and health-conscious everyday cooking.

name: 3-Piece Non-Stick Granite Cookware Induction Pot & Pan Set
description: Cook delicious meals with minimal oil. Multi-layer induction base heats evenly across gas, ceramic, and induction stoves. Scratch-resistant, 100% PFOA-free and easy to clean.

name: JBL Flip 6 Portable Waterproof Bluetooth Speaker (Bold 2-Way Audio)
description: The beat goes on with the JBL Flip 6 2-way speaker system. Engineered to deliver loud, crystal clear, powerful audio with racetrack-shaped woofer, separate tweeter, and dual pumping passive radiators.

name: Nescafe Gold Blend Rich & Smooth Instant Coffee (200g Glass Jar)
description: Nescafe Gold Blend is crafted with high-altitude Arabica beans roasted to golden perfection. Unlocks rich aroma and smooth, velvety taste in every cup of morning brew.

name: Fossil Grant Chronograph Navy Blue Leather Watch (FS4835)
description: The quintessential gentleman's dress chronograph. Features a handsome midnight blue sunray dial framed in a polished rose gold stainless steel case, paired with a supple genuine calfskin leather strap.

name: Leather Chelsea Boots
description: Zara Men Chelsea boots featuring elasticated side gores, a durable pull tab, and a cushioned crepe-textured outsole. Versatile design suitable for casual denim or formal tailored trousers.

name: Al Madina Premium Jumbo Medjool Soft Dates (1kg Royal Box)
description: Known as the King of Dates, these premium jumbo Medjool dates feature plump, glossy skin, melt-in-your-mouth soft flesh, and a rich caramel sweetness. 100% natural, rich in fiber, potassium, and essential minerals.

name: Apple AirPods Pro (2nd Generation) MagSafe Case
description: AirPods Pro (2nd generation) with USB-C delivers up to 2x more Active Noise Cancellation than the previous generation, with Transparency mode that lets you hear the world around you, and all-new Adaptive Audio that dynamically tailors noise control to your environment.

name: New Balance 574 Core Classic Retro Sneakers (Grey / White)
description: The most iconic New Balance shoe ever made. Created as a reliable hybrid road-and-trail design, the 574 features time-tested ENCAP midsole cushioning that delivers lightweight all-day comfort.

name: Nature Made Triple Strength Fish Oil Omega-3 1200mg (120 Softgels)
description: Molecularly distilled to remove mercury, PCBs, and heavy metals. Helps maintain healthy heart rhythm, supports cardiovascular flexibility, enhances joint comfort, and promotes sharp cognitive brain function.

name: Air Running Sneakers
description: The Nike Air Running Sneakers offer a springy ride for every run, familiar feel just for you. This version has the same responsiveness and neutral support you love, with improved comfort in sensitive areas like the arch and toes.

name: Anua Heartleaf 77% Soothing Toner (250ml)
description: Anua Heartleaf 77% Soothing Toner regulates moisture and sebum production while deeply soothing sensitive or irritated skin. Tested non-comedogenic and ideal for acne-prone skin.

name: COSRX Advanced Snail 96 Mucin Power Essence (100ml)
description: Formulated with 96.3% Snail Secretion Filtrate, this essence protects the skin from moisture loss while improving skin elasticity. Snail mucin helps repair and soothes red, sensitized skin post-breakouts by replenishing moisture.

name: Traditional Bilona Pure Grass-Fed Cow Ghee (500g Glass Jar)
description: Prepared through the ancient Vedic Bilona method using whole cultured curd from grass-fed local cows. Slowly simmered over low fire to develop signature golden granular texture (Daandar) and heavenly nostalgic aroma.

name: Logitech MX Master 3S Wireless Performance Mouse (8K DPI, Quiet Clicks)
description: The ultimate productivity mouse reimagined with Quiet Click technology that reduces 90% click noise while maintaining satisfying tactile feel. MagSpeed scroll wheel scrolls 1000 lines in a second.

name: Twinings of London Pure Green Tea & Jasmine (25 Foil Wrapped Bags)
description: Expertly blended pure green tea scented with sweet, fragrant jasmine blossoms. Light, floral, and deeply refreshing, providing a calm antioxidant boost for everyday wellness.

name: Clarks Tilden Cap Oxford Shoes
description: A sharp cap toe oxford crafted with rich leather uppers, discreet elastic gore for a custom fit, and an impact-absorbing OrthoLite footbed that ensures comfort throughout long corporate days.

name: Paula's Choice 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant (118ml)
description: A global cult favorite, Paula's Choice 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant quickly exfoliates dead skin cells while clearing pores for a more even, radiant tone. Formulated with green tea extract to calm redness.

name: Philips Avent Ultra Air Soother Pacifier Set (0-6m, 2-Pack)
description: A light, breathable pacifier for sensitive baby skin. Philips Avent Ultra Air features extra-large air holes that let skin breathe, keeping it dry while soothing with a silky-soft textured silicone teat.

name: Chanel Bleu De Chanel Pour Homme EDP (100ml)
description: BLEU DE CHANEL Eau de Parfum is an aromatic-woody fragrance with ambery and musky notes. A sensual interpretation in which dry cedar notes lend sensual warmth, while New Caledonian sandalwood brings elegance and depth.

name: Traditional Handloom Pure Muslin Silk Saree (Crimson Red)
description: Celebrate festivals and wedding ceremonies with this lightweight, feather-soft pure Muslin silk saree. Handcrafted by master weavers with intricate metallic zari palla.

name: Fisher-Price Deluxe Kick & Play Piano Baby Gym
description: With 4 ways to play as your baby grows (lay and play, tummy time, sit and play, and take along), this musical activity gym keeps little ones entertained with 65+ songs, sounds, tunes, and phrases.

name: Casio Edifice Sapphire Chronograph Quartz Watch (EFB-680D-1AV)
description: Sporty yet sophisticated Japanese chronograph timepiece. Built with virtually scratch-proof sapphire crystal glass, 100-meter water resistance, precision 1/10-second stopwatch, and solid stainless steel link bracelet.

name: Double Wall Vacuum Insulated Tumbler (750ml)
description: Engineered with double-wall vacuum insulation and sweat-proof powder coating. Keeps your iced beverages frosty cold for 24 hours or steaming hot coffee fresh for 12 hours. Fits seamlessly into car cup holders.

name: Philips Smart Wi-Fi LED Ambient Desk & Bedside Lamp
description: Bring warm ambiance to any bedroom or study setup. Offers 16 million colors, customizable circadian rhythm schedules, and seamless compatibility with Google Home and Alexa via Wi-Fi.

name: Heavyweight 220 GSM Supima Cotton T-Shirt
description: Constructed with premium 220 GSM long-staple combed cotton for substantial drape and non-translucent durability. Features double-needle coverstitched hems and reactive color dyeing that withstands dozens of washes.

name: The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% (30ml)
description: The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% is a water-based serum that boosts skin brightness, improves skin smoothness, and reinforces the skin barrier over time. Formulated with a high concentration of niacinamide (vitamin B3) supported by zinc PCA to balance visible sebum activity.

name: CeraVe Daily Moisturizing Lotion (237ml)
description: Developed with dermatologists, CeraVe Daily Moisturizing Lotion has a unique, lightweight formula that provides 24-hour hydration and helps restore the protective skin barrier with three essential ceramides (1, 3, 6-II). Utilizes patented MVE delivery technology.

name: California Roasted & Salted Jumbo Almonds (500g Air-Tight Pouch)
description: High-protein premium nonpareil California almonds, slowly dry-roasted to golden crisp perfection without any added vegetable oils. Lightly sprinkled with Himalayan rock salt for a healthy, energizing daily snack.

name: Versace Eros Flame Eau De Parfum (100ml)
description: Versace Eros Flame is a fragrance for a strong, passionate, self-confident man who is deeply in touch with his emotions. Characterized by strong contrasts in which the most noble and elegant ingredients enrich and enhance one another.

name: Deep Tissue Percussion Muscle Massage Gun (6-Speed, 4 Attachments)
description: Engineered for athletes and everyday office professionals suffering from neck, back, or leg tightness. Delivers up to 3200 RPM deep percussive pulses with ultra-quiet motor technology and 4 hours battery life.

name: Bella Vita Luxury Organic Unisex Perfume Set (4x20ml)
description: A curated discovery set of premium artisanal EDP perfumes. Perfect for personal gifting and travel, delivering all-day fragrance variety from fresh aquatic morning notes to royal white oud evening sophistication.

name: Johnson's Baby Head-to-Toe Wash & Lotion Set (500ml)
description: Specially formulated to cleanse and nourish baby's delicate skin without drying. Tested with pediatricians and dermatologists to be hypoallergenic and free of harsh parabens, sulfates, and dyes.

name: Omron Automatic Upper Arm Digital Blood Pressure Monitor (HEM-7120)
description: Japanese precision clinical blood pressure monitor for home health tracking. Features irregular heartbeat detection, cuff wrapping guide, body movement sensor, and last memory recall for peace of mind.

name: Handloom Floral Georgette Party Saree
description: An ethereal blend of traditional Bangladeshi handloom weaving and contemporary pastel floral aesthetics. Light as air and effortlessly drapeable, accompanied by an unstitched contrast designer blouse piece.

name: Nordic Minimalist Ceramic Fluted Flower Vase (Matte Off-White)
description: Elevate your interior aesthetics with this Scandinavian-inspired fluted vase. High-temperature fired with a matte unglazed tactile exterior and glazed waterproof interior.

name: Xiaomi Smart Band 8 Pro AMOLED Fitness Tracker
description: Upgrade your daily fitness with the Xiaomi Smart Band 8 Pro. Features an expansive 1.74-inch 60Hz AMOLED screen, integrated GPS, all-day SpO2, heart-rate monitoring, and up to 14 days of battery endurance.

name: Accu-Chek Active Blood Glucose Monitor Kit (with 50 Test Strips)
description: Accurate, hassle-free glucometer kit designed for painless blood sugar testing at home. Features 500-result memory tracking, 7/14/30/90-day averages, and visual double-check strip window.

name: 40oz Vacuum Insulated Stainless Steel Tumbler with Straw
description: Keep hydration within reach all day long. Double-wall vacuum insulation maintains drinks ice-cold for 24 hours or steaming hot for 12 hours. Rotating 3-way lid accommodates reusable straw or direct sipping.

name: Samsung Galaxy Watch 6 Bluetooth (44mm)
description: Start your everyday wellness journey with Samsung Galaxy Watch 6. Featuring a 20% larger screen and a 30% slimmer bezel, complete with personalized HR zones, comprehensive sleep analysis, and fast wireless charging.

name: Baseus Bowie M2+ ANC True Wireless Earbuds
description: Baseus Bowie M2+ delivers high-fidelity acoustic performance with deep -42dB active noise cancellation, 30 hours of total playtime, and seamless dual device auto switching.

name: Handcrafted Full-Grain Vegetable-Tanned Leather Bi-Fold Wallet
description: Crafted by master leather artisans from 100% vegetable-tanned full-grain cowhide leather that ages gracefully over time. Built with specialized RFID-blocking woven mesh to safeguard your credit cards from unauthorized scans.

name: Tom Ford Oud Wood Eau De Parfum (50ml Unisex)
description: One of the most rare, precious, and expensive ingredients in a perfumer's arsenal, oud wood is often burned in incense-filled temples of Bhutan. Exotic rose wood and cardamom give way to a smoky blend of rare oud wood, sandalwood and vetiver.

name: Heavyweight Washed Denim Trucker Jacket (Vintage Indigo)
description: Constructed from heavy 13.5oz selvedge-grade denim with artisanal hand-scraping and vintage wash. Features dual button-flap chest pockets and adjustable waist tabs.

name: Tissot PRX Powermatic 80 Blue Dial Automatic Watch (T137.407.11.041.00)

name: Executive Crisp Slim Fit Oxford Cotton Shirt

name: Ultrasonic Aroma Essential Oil Diffuser (500ml)
description: Transform your bedroom, living room, or study into a serene oasis. The ultrasonic diffuser atomizes pure water and essential oils without heat, keeping the therapeutic integrity intact while adding gentle humidity to air-conditioned rooms.

name: Kindle Paperwhite 16GB (6.8-Inch Glare-Free Display, Warm Light)
description: Designed specifically for book lovers. Features an adjustable warm light from white to amber, 10 weeks of battery life on a single USB-C charge, and 20% faster page turns. IPX8 waterproof for reading anywhere.

name: Nike Air Max Impact Cushioned Running Shoes
description: Designed for daily comfort, fitness runs, and street lifestyle. Features Nike Air Max unit in the heel for maximum impact absorption and lightweight responsiveness.

name: Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun: Rice + Probiotics SPF50+ (50ml)

name: Dymatize ISO100 Hydrolyzed 100% Whey Protein Isolate (Chocolate 5 lbs)
description: Dymatize ISO100 is formulated for rapid muscle recovery and lean gains. Multi-step microfiltration removes excess carbohydrates, fat, lactose, and cholesterol for clean athletic performance.

name: Seiko 5 Sports Automatic Steel Watch (Black Dial, SRPD55K1)
description: Legendary Japanese automatic sports watch. Equipped with Seiko's robust in-house 4R36 movement with manual winding and hacking seconds, uni-directional rotating dive bezel, and see-through case back.

name: Levi's 511 Slim Fit Stretch Denim Jeans
description: A modern slim with room to move, the 511 Slim Fit Stretch Jeans are a classic. These jeans are cut close to the body with 1% elastane for built-in recovery and comfortable flexibility throughout the day.

name: Casual Canvas Shoes
description: Casual Canvas Sneakers — a premium footwear piece from Adidas, crafted for style and all-day comfort. Features a breathable dual-layer canvas upper, cushioned vulcanized rubber outsole, reinforced heel cup, and iconic low-profile silhouette suitable for daily street-ready wear.

name: Luxury Semi-Formal Linen Shirt for Men (Ice Blue)
description: Tailored for effortless sophistication in tropical weather, this pure linen blend shirt keeps you cool while maintaining sharp corporate and smart-casual elegance.

name: Barilla Collezione Italian Penne Rigate Durum Wheat Pasta (500g)
description: Barilla Collezione Penne Rigate is crafted from the highest quality non-GMO durum wheat semolina. Bronze-die cut produces a rough surface that holds sauce beautifully for authentic al dente texture.

name: Afnan 9 PM Eau De Parfum (100ml)
description: Afnan 9 PM is designed for magnetic night outs and memorable gatherings. Opens with crispy bergamot and fresh wild apple before deepening into creamy vanilla and cedarwood.

name: Classic Stan Smith
description: Originally created for tennis star Stan Smith in 1971, this iconic sneaker has stood the test of time. Features a premium leather upper, signature green heel tab, perforated 3-Stripes, and an OrthoLite sockliner for comfort and performance.

name: La Roche-Posay Anthelios UVmune 400 SPF50+ (50ml)

name: Centrum Adult Complete Multivitamin & Mineral Tablets (130 Tablets)
description: Clinically formulated with essential vitamins A, C, D3, E, Zinc, and B-complex to support daily physical energy, healthy immune function, eye health, and metabolic performance.

name: Combed Cotton Athleisure Jogger Pants (Charcoal Grey)
